speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: asked the Minister for Health whether there will be a review of the enforcement measures on vaping users and sellers of vaporisers and consumables.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: The Health Sciences Authority (HSA) oversees enforcements and works closely with the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) in relation to illegal imports of e-vaporisers.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: There are also common misconceptions regarding the harm of e-vaporisers.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
text: I have several concerned residents and parents and despite the current efforts – education, outreach, enforcements – there is still an upward trajectory.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
text: So, I would like to ask the Senior Parliamentary Secretary what more can be done to reverse this trend and if you have done sufficient – given enough effort to reach out to our youths, to educate them on the adverse effects?

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: Indeed, it is a problem that we are also very concerned about, which is why we are working very closely with the different partners at different parts of the equation.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: We are working with ICA to stop the illegal imports and with schools, HPB is also working in educating students about the harms of vaping.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: So, this is an ongoing review that we are looking at.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: There is a larger effort in looking at the tobacco control measures.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: This is something that we probably have to take multi-faceted approach and also to walk together with the public.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: This awareness is something that we have to push through a lot more.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: Hopefully, with all these efforts, we will be able to build greater awareness and create better enforcement so that we can reduce the incidence of vaping amongst our young.
